create_demux_config: create a demux config object to load headerless audio files with a specified format
create_decode_config: create a decode config object to specify a custom decoder like libopenh264 for video
create_cuda_config: create a CUDA config object to specify device index and custom CUDA stream for GPU transfer
create_video_encode_config: create a video encode config object to customize encoding parameters like frame rate and bit rate
create_audio_encode_config: create an audio encode config object to customize encoding parameters like sample rate and channels
